CustomField.label: Below Floor
CustomField.description: Net unit price is below the tier floor price (PRC-18). Drives the VP Sales then Finance approval (phase 5). Promotion discounts are excluded: on a promotional line the price before promotion (all other discounts applied) is compared with the floor.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked when the net unit price, not counting promotion discounts, is below the floor price – the quote needs VP Sales then Finance approval.
CustomField.formula: AND(NOT(ISBLANK(MB_Floor_Price__c)), IF(MB_Promotion_Applied__c, BLANKVALUE(MB_Price_Before_Promotion__c, NetUnitPrice), NetUnitPrice) < MB_Floor_Price__c)
